name: aiops-sql-json
description: Edit, validate, and highlight multiline SQL in .sql.json files.

commands.title: AIOps SQL JSON: Go to Matching SQL Bracket
AIOps SQL JSON: Toggle Safe SQL Comment
AIOps SQL JSON: Toggle Safe SQL Block Comment
AIOps SQL JSON: Force Rebuild Schema Index

aiopsSqlJson.keyPatterns.markdownDescription: Case-sensitive glob patterns used to identify SQL properties. `*` matches any number of characters, `?` matches one character, and multiple patterns are combined with OR semantics.

aiopsSqlJson.multilineStrings.allowAll.markdownDescription: Whether physical line breaks are allowed in every JSON string. When disabled, only direct string values whose property names match `aiopsSqlJson.keyPatterns` may span physical lines.

aiopsSqlJson.dialect.markdownDescription: The SQL dialect used for both embedded SQL and regular `.sql` files.

aiopsSqlJson.plainSql.enabled.markdownDescription: Whether this extension provides completion, syntax validation, and semantic highlighting for regular `.sql` files.

aiopsSqlJson.schemaValidation.enabled.markdownDescription: Whether to validate SQL table, column, and function references against the DDL files configured by `aiopsSqlJson.schemaFiles`. This is an offline static check and does not connect to a database.

aiopsSqlJson.schemaValidation.completion.markdownDescription: When Schema validation is enabled, use the indexed DDL for Schema-aware completion but suppress all Schema-derived query and DDL diagnostics. Regular SQL, JSON, and platform diagnostics remain enabled.

aiopsSqlJson.schemaFiles.markdownDescription: Glob patterns for `.sql` files containing explicit `CREATE TABLE` and inferable `CREATE VIEW` DDL. Supports stable VS Code path variables such as `${workspaceFolder}`, `${fileDirname}`, `${userHome}`, and `${env:NAME}`.

aiopsSqlJson.udfs.markdownDescription: User-defined SQL function names to include in completion and accept during schema validation. Signatures and argument types are not checked.

aiopsSqlJson.placeholderPatterns.markdownDescription: Regular expression sources for template placeholders to mask with equal-length text before parsing. Expressions run in global Unicode mode; SQL validation is strict by default.

aiopsSqlJson.placeholders.allowEverywher.markdownDescription: Whether placeholder patterns may appear in strings, unquoted property keys, and bare JSON tokens throughout `.sql.json` files. When disabled, placeholders are masked only while validating recognized SQL strings and regular `.sql` files.

scripts.check: npm run check:types && npm run lint
scripts.pretest:integration: npm run build && npm run compile:test
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.package: npm run test && vsce package --out aiops-sql-json.vsix
